dedupe_keys.name: mobilitatsdaten osterreich austrian national access point for mobility data

description: Mobilitaetsdaten.gv.at is Austria's national access point under the Austrian ITS Act. It collects and presents information on mobility data from private and public data holders to give an overview and make data access easier for service operators, bringing local data providers together with international service operators. Its listings cover alternative fuels and parking information (including who owns infrastructure data and whether availability is measured), road infrastructure, categorisations and ancillary facilities, and commercial facilities, loading zones, truck infrastructure and safety infrastructure; news items feature local mobility services. Coverage: Austria. Format and access: a metadata catalogue linking to providers. Licence and cost: free to browse; terms per dataset. Caveats: the site is in German and holds descriptions, not the data. It supports network flow and emergency response studies using Austrian traffic and infrastructure data. It relates to the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: Mobilitätsdaten Österreich: Austrian national access point for mobility data
